systems.country_label: plateforme nationale de signalement de la Police nationale
systems.platform: Website and Android application; software not named
systems.owner: Police nationale; developed under the Ministère de la Sécurité publique, the Direction des systèmes d'information et des transmissions and the Brigade féminine de police
systems.tiers: Public, online, national; said to complement other channels of contact with the security forces and proximity mechanisms on the ground

note: The only system is a public portal for filing and tracking reports of gender-based violence and disappearances (class public); nothing on records made at stations.
